claim: Small finite computational checks, NOT a proof of the restriction lemma.

method.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exclusively; all stored rationals are numerator/denominator strings
method.exhaustive_scope: All canonical clause multisets up to the stated clause-count bound, including false and repeated clauses. Clause order is canonical, but every occurrence retains a separate index. NOT all CNFs.
method.geometric_filter: Compare E W <= 1/(1-theta) only if theta < 1; E W_j <= theta^j and finite-sum bounds checked for all theta.
method.limitations: Bounded dimensions and bounded exhaustive clause multiplicities; seeded formulas only supplement that class. No formal proof and no claim of exhaustive coverage of unbounded CNFs.
method.literal_convention: signed 1-based literals; null clause=true; [] clause=false; [] CNF=true
method.maximum_ratios: Separate maxima by (b,p,k,j); zero coefficient bounds counted separately without dividing by zero. Ties keep the first deterministic witness.
method.mixtures: Exact permutation counts grouped by passing prefix subsets; I_h objects retain true/false clauses and repetitions after final substitution. Product of marginals avoids enumerating cross-products.
method.paths: All scope-defined indexed paths, including incompatible paths; c_U counts every retained fully prescribed violated clause index, not just selected indices.
method.pointwise: Raw literal substitution and evaluation vs signed path expansion; zero numerator means zero fraction; residual identities also checked.
method.restriction_scope: Every one of 3^d restrictions and every live assignment (4^d restriction/point pairs per formula and b). No Monte Carlo expectations.
method.reverse: Direct finite F_s(R) recurrence, literal V_R counts and factorization; only for the configured formulas. Never used to set W_j or expectations.
method.reweighting: Independent pointwise c_U counts give conditional and full-assignment expectation identities.

naive_gate_fanin_extension.scope: counterexample to substituting maximum gate fanin for CNF width; NOT to the original lemma
naive_gate_fanin_extension.witness: G=2H-1; dual: all 1-CNF subcubes; primal: satisfying singleton subcubes
